shadbala.heading: Shadbala Analysis
shadbala.intro: Shadbala measures six-fold planetary strength. A strength ratio above 1.0 indicates the planet meets its required minimum; below 0.7 signals an area that may need conscious reinforcement. The summary normalizes each planet against its own required minimum before ranking it.

sthanaBala.label: Sthana Bala
sthanaBala.description: Positional strength from sign, house, decanate, and divisional chart placement

digBala.label: Dig Bala
digBala.description: Directional strength based on angular house alignment

kalaBala.label: Kala Bala
kalaBala.description: Temporal strength from day/night and lunar phase

drikBala.label: Drik Bala
drikBala.description: Aspectual strength from benefic and malefic aspects

shadbala.signContextIntro: Shadbala ranks planets, not signs. The sign labels below come from Sarvashtakavarga totals: more bindus indicate relatively more support when that sign's field is activated, while fewer indicate a need for more care. They are not a verdict on a zodiac sign or a standalone prediction.
shadbala.strongestSignMatch: Its natal placement also falls in a highest-SAV sign. Treat both as separate contextual indicators, not a combined score.
shadbala.strongestSignNoMatch: This measures planetary capacity separately from the SAV sign score; the two should not be averaged.
shadbala.weakestSignMatch: Its natal placement also falls in a lowest-SAV sign. Treat both as separate contextual indicators, not a combined score.
shadbala.weakestSignNoMatch: A lower SAV sign is a different signal from a lower Shadbala planet, so read both in their own context.
shadbala.unavailableTitle: Sign-level context is unavailable for this reading.
shadbala.unavailableBody: Shadbala still identifies the strongest and weakest planets above, but it cannot by itself identify a strongest or weakest sign. SAV data was not included, so no sign-level conclusion is being inferred.

ashtakavarga.heading: Ashtakavarga
ashtakavarga.intro: Each sign is scored on how much planetary support it carries. Higher scores mark the areas where things tend to move more easily for you.

yogas.heading: Planetary Yogas
yogas.intro: Yogas are classical planetary combinations that shape life patterns. Each yoga below was detected in this natal chart based on planet positions, sign rulership, and house placement.
yogas.empty: No yogas found in this category for this chart.
yogas.detailFallback: {name} is one of the strongest detected combinations in this chart, so its effects deserve more weight than the lighter matches below.
yogas.activationStrong: Most active during involved planet dashas and major transits to the yoga houses.
yogas.activationModerate: Most noticeable when the involved planets are emphasized by dasha or transit.
yogas.activationWeak: Usually situational, becoming visible during short transit triggers or focused life choices.
